conditional_accounting_note: I(B;label)+I(B;receipt|label)=I(B;label,receipt). The ideal XOR bank has0+1bit conditional accounting despite0+0 unconditional marginal information. This is the classical chain rule, not a novel budget theorem.
interpretation: These are exact information quantities of the realized equally weighted four-cell(B,R) source bank in each fixed public world. They do not calibrate the underlying stochastic LLM kernel, establish repeated-generation privacy costs, or replace receiver behavior/causal controls. All malformed/noncompliant source actions remain included through the frozen host fallback.
